ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms mesh services, transport security and the plaintext-fallback flag are declared; it does not show traffic is actually encrypted.
offer: Enumerate mesh participants and require authenticated encrypted service traffic. Plaintext fallback undermines the declared mesh boundary and must not be implicit.

minimal.reason: List the services that participate in the mesh. A service outside the list is outside the boundary, so enumerate each participant.

mid.reason: Declare the transport security mode, such as mutual TLS. Without it service traffic may be unauthenticated, so state the required mode.

maximal.reason: Set allowing plaintext fallback to false. A silent downgrade undermines the declared boundary, so reject unencrypted connections.
